note: A five-note tune made only of the home chord's notes (Do Mi Sol Mi Do), played along on the neck. The old Key selector is now moves (any key, 60 to 80 bpm), so the title and text name the key only as {{=key}}, and a {{?key}} line says what stays the same in another key. The goal is a feel: hearing the next note before playing it.

exercise.title: A Do Mi Sol tune in {{=key}}
exercise.why: The tune uses only the three notes of the home chord, one at a time, so your fingers learn a triad as a melody and your ear learns how its notes sound in turn.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune and see each note light on the neck. It goes {{1}}, {{3}}, {{5}}, back to {{3}} and home to {{1}}: the notes of the {{=key}} chord, one at a time.
Play along with it, one note per beat.
Practice until you can hear the next note in your head before you play it.
{{?key}}In another key the tune sits on other frets, and it is still the same three notes of the chord, up and back home.
